siteMeta.title: A Storybook for Kritika 📖✨
siteMeta.subtitle: A little bundle of love for the birthday girl

guesses.text: You are currently bundled up in your coziest blanket, sipping something warm.
Your hands or sketchbook have some stray paint streaks from a sudden burst of creativity.
You have mentally scheduled at least three different cake tastings this week.
A song came on recently and you couldn't help doing a private dance routine in your room.
You were wondering if everyone forgot your belated celebration... (Never in a million years!).

chapters.heading: The Friends Corkboard
chapters.intro: Tap any Polaroid to flip it and read the note on the back!

entries.caption: Late night giggle fits
entries.message: Happy belated birthday Lucky! Missing our endless tea sessions and spontaneous dance breaks. Get fully rested and back on your feet soon—we have so many adventures lined up!

entries.caption: Watercolor chaos
entries.message: To the undisputed queen of creativity and dance floor energy: so glad to know you! Wishing you the happiest, healthiest year ahead. Don't stop painting!

entries.caption: Sweet tooth crew
entries.message: Nobody appreciates a delicious slice of chocolate cake quite like you do. We saved the biggest slice for our reunion celebration! Get well soon and shine on!

chapters.heading: Family Album
chapters.intro: Treasured memories and blessings from home.

entries.caption: Our radiant sunshine
entries.message: Watching you grow with so much warmth, kindness, and talent brings us endless joy. May this coming year shower you with vibrant health, glowing happiness, and laughter every single day.

entries.caption: Warmest blessings
entries.message: Sending all my love, prayers, and heartfelt blessings to my sweetest Lucky beta. Always keep that charming smile on your face.

chapters.heading: Sibling Shenanigans
chapters.intro: Things only siblings understand (and argue about).

entries.caption: Official Cake Stealer
entries.message: Happy Birthday Lucky! I promise I only took ONE bite of your birthday cake while you weren't looking. Okay maybe two. Thanks for being the coolest partner in crime!

chapters.heading: Cousin Postcards
chapters.intro: Summer letters from across the miles.

entries.caption: Next reunion loading...
entries.message: Dear Lucky, vacations and family holidays are never quite as energetic without your dance routines and laughs. Rest up, recharge, and get ready for our next hangout!

closingLetter.title: A Note from Prem
closingLetter.message:
Hey Kritika,

We know being unwell on your birthday wasn't in the plan, but birthdays don't expire—and neither does how much everyone loves and cherishes you.

Take all the time you need to recover, drink all the warm tea, and let this little scrapbook remind you of all the love and smiles waiting for you on the other side.

Happy Belated Birthday, Lucky! 🎂✨
